ISSN 1432-0827 (online) confirmed via ISSN Portal; 0171-967X (print) via search. Publisher Springer (Springer US / Springer Nature); hybrid open-access journal.
Springer standard 'Text' boilerplate surfaced in search ('normal, plain font, e.g., 10-point Times Roman') is an EXAMPLE not a mandate -> layout.font left null.
Submission system almost certainly Editorial Manager (Springer default) but NOT verified from the blocked guide -> submission_system null.

Guide section headings reported by search (standard Springer template): Types of Papers, Manuscript Submission, Title Page, Text, Scientific style, References, Tables, Artwork and Illustrations Guidelines, Supplementary Information — individual values inside these sections were unreadable.

Enum-typed fields lacking a null option (references.style, references.order, tables.placement/numbering, figures.legends_location) were set null/neutral because the guide was unreadable; references.style set to 'custom' as the least-committal enum value (actual style unverified — Springer/CTI is likely a numbered bracket style but this was NOT confirmed from the guide). layout.line_numbers left 'none' as conservative default (not verified).
All blinding flags false: no evidence CTI uses double-blind/anonymized review (Springer default is single-blind); unverified.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'custom').
[schema-required default] references.journal_abbrev defaulted to 'nlm' (guide silent; NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations assumed).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
